title: Chaqaloq taxminan 270 ta suyak bilan tug'iladi

scenes.text: Olimlar hisobicha, chaqaloq taxminan 270 ta suyak bilan tug'iladi.
Katta odamda esa odatda 206 ta bo'ladi, lekin suyaklar yo'qolib ketmaydi.
Bola o'sgan sari ko'p suyaklar bir-biriga qo'shilib ketadi.
Masalan, chaqaloqning bosh suyagi ham alohida bo'laklardan iborat bo'ladi.

description: Chaqaloq taxminan 270 ta suyak bilan tug'iladi (turli manbalarda 270 dan 300 gacha deyiladi). Ularning ko'pi xaftaga bo'lib, bola o'sgan sari qotadi va bir-biriga qo'shiladi, masalan bosh suyagi bo'laklari. Shuning uchun katta odamda odatda 206 ta suyak bo'ladi.
source: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/books/NBK537199/ (NIH StatPearls, Anatomy, Bones: about 270 bones at birth, 206 in adults); https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/books/NBK441968/ (NIH StatPearls, Physiology, Bone); https://health.clevelandclinic.org/how-many-bones-does-a-baby-have; https://www.popsci.com/story/health/bones-human-skeleton/ (about 300, extra bones fuse, not lost); https://kidshealth.org/ChildrensHealthNetwork/en/kids/bones.html (skull gaps)
